Running containerized AI models on Linux? 🐧🐳

By default, Docker containers operate completely isolated from your physical GPUs. To enable hardware acceleration for frameworks like PyTorch or vLLM, you must bridge the host drivers to your container runtime using the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.



Read the step-by-step terminal guide:
https://www.gtzhost.com/tutorials/howto/install-nvidia-container-toolkit-docker-ubuntu-26-04/
